shortDescription: Information module for Network Device Replacements

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_host
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center hostname.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_port
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center port.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: family
options.description: Family query parameter. Faulty device family.

options.name: faultyDeviceName
options.description: FaultyDeviceName query parameter. Faulty device name.

options.name: faultyDevicePlatform
options.description: FaultyDevicePlatform query parameter. Faulty device platform.

options.name: faultyDeviceSerialNumber
options.description: FaultyDeviceSerialNumber query parameter. Faulty device serial number.

options.name: headers
options.description: Additional headers.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. Instance UUID of the device replacement.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page. Maximum value can be 500.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1.

options.name: replacementDevicePlatform
options.description: ReplacementDevicePlatform query parameter. Replacement device platform.

options.name: replacementDeviceSerialNumber
options.description: ReplacementDeviceSerialNumber query parameter. Replacement device serial number.

options.name: replacementStatus
options.description: ReplacementStatus query parameter. Device replacement status. Available values MARKED_FOR_REPLACEMENT, NETWORK_READINESS_REQUESTED, NETWORK_READINESS_FAILED, READY_FOR_REPLACEMENT, REPLACEMENT_SCHEDULED, REPLACEMENT_IN_PROGRESS, REPLACED, ERROR. Replacement status 'MARKED_FOR_REPLACEMENT' - The faulty device has been marked for replacement. options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. A property within the response to sort by. Available values id, creationTime, family, faultyDeviceId, fautyDeviceName, faultyDevicePlatform, faultyDeviceSerialNumber, replacementDevicePlatform, replacementDeviceSerialNumber, replacementTime.

options.name: sortOrder
options.description: SortOrder query parameter. Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response. Available values ASC, DESC.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
